package.name: circe_teensy
package.description:
The Teensy 4.0 I/O board for CIRCE: BMS, ultrasonic rangers, e-stop button, GPS and the cable spool motor, talking to the Pi 5 over USB serial (/dev/teensy). teensy_bridge.py turns the Teensy's frames into ROS topics and forwards spool commands and odometry to it.
The firmware is a PlatformIO project rooted in this directory (platformio.ini, src/, include/, lib/). colcon builds it when PlatformIO is installed and installs firmware.hex to share/circe_teensy/firmware/. Building never flashes the board.
